L1.details: Chipyard commit is present, but recursive exact submodule lock is not clean or complete.

L2.details: Targeted Chipyard/Gemmini dependencies, FireSim targetutils, CIRCT firtool-1.75.0 and DRAMSim2 were installed in the isolated work tree. Official GemminiRocketConfig elaborated, firtool emitted split Verilog, and Verilator built the simulator. mvin/mvout, FAST=1 matmul, FAST=1 matmul_ws, and official N=2 matmul_os have provenance-backed PASS evidence. Fresh canonical N=2 matmul_ws timed out at 10,000,001 cycles without a mismatch; its historical 20M $finish log has no captured invocation or binary hash and is not authoritative. Full N=2 default matmul reached the 20,000,001-cycle TestDriver timeout after several dataflow/transpose combinations; no numerical mismatch was reported. Full ResNet numerical RTL gate is still open.

L3.details: Docker is not installed, so the official AHA Garnet/map/PnR/test flow cannot run.

gemmini_software_compile.details: bare-metal Gemmini binaries and libgemmini.so were built with local RISC-V wrappers

gemmini_spike_extension.details: Spike loaded libgemmini.so and libcustomext.so together via LD_PRELOAD; mvin and matmul completed. ResNet bare-metal remains a separate failure gate.

official_gemmini_rtl.details: First official macro-level Gemmini RTL artifact was emitted at 2026-08-25 03:11:38 +0800 (`gen-collateral/ChipTop.sv`); the cycle-accurate Verilator simulator was linked at 03:17:10 +0800. This is not yet the hetero_npu integrated top or TSMC SRAM-macro implementation.

official_gemmini_micro_regression.details: Pinned official generated MacUnit passed 327,680 exhaustive signed INT8 x INT8 plus five 20-bit accumulator cases. This closes a primitive-level official RTL functional gate, not full Gemmini/RocketTile equivalence.

official_gemmini_micro_dc.details: The pinned generated MacUnit behind a one-stage timing wrapper synthesized with the TSMC CLN22UL SVT .db at 1.0 ns: 0 unmapped cells, WNS=0.000536978 ns, 23 leaf cells. This is primitive-level evidence; no SRAM macro is involved.

gemmini_rocc_adapter.details: 128-bit Matrix GEMM/GEMV/CONV command translation, RoCC response event, illegal command and ready/valid backpressure pass in 6 cycles. TSMC CLN22UL SVT DC at 1.0 ns reports 0 unmapped and WNS=0.0107245 ns. PTW/TileLink/Rocket status context remains external.

gemmini_rocc_integration.details: The command scoreboard and hetero shell route a Matrix command through the RoCC adapter and a non-Matrix SFU command through the contract path; host events, response and illegal flags pass in 12 cycles. TSMC DC reports 0 unmapped and WNS=0.000330031 ns. Official PTW/TileLink context is still an external boundary.

cleanroom_integrated_dc.details: TSMC CLN22UL SVT typical/max .db, 1.0 ns clock, 0 unmapped cells, WNS=9.75132e-05 ns. Macro Count=0 because this is the clean-room flop-array contract, not production SRAM macro integration.

L11.details: Clean-room integrated Matrix/SFU/KV RTL passes concurrent deterministic ready/valid numerical regression in 20 measured cycles. The same L11 report now includes shell/command-scoreboard to wrapper-only Gemmini RoCC integration in 12 measured cycles. Functional model cases pass q128/q384, decode context4096 and continuous requests with COW. Official Gemmini remains a separate generated/simulated baseline.
